claim_checks.area: Every number: instrument, completed session and horizon
claim_checks.result: Matched Treasury 4.62%/4.28%/-34 bps, twenty-observation -25/-19/+6 bps and inverted bull steepening to the Treasury card. All quoted index, local PLN tracker/banks, USD equity and sector/credit ETF closes and signed daily/twenty-session moves checked to completed 2024-07-10 observations. Apple 232.98/+20.64% is Apple, Meta 534.69/+6.38% is Meta; TSMC 191.05/+3.54%/+13.61% is the US ADR. HYG/LQD prices are not spread or flow quantities. Bitcoin/Ether use completed 2024-07-10 UTC daily closes with distinct daily signs. July 27 conference date matches Reuters title; no numeric spot FX, invented estimate or target.

All 82 cited full titles read. TSMC revenue is released sales evidence available before cutoff, not a full earnings or margin statement; potential wafer pricing remains reported possibility. US CPI, bank results and China loans are consistently pending. Loan surge is Reuters poll, EIA/OPEC demand is forecast, Yahoo S&P493 earnings breadth is attributed interpretation. Every ordinary company/trade/political headline is inside seven days; macro inflation/wage/housing baselines fit their wider semantic window. No same-date unreleased result or later outcome was used.

Oracle/xAI ending negotiations is not a canceled booked contract or a collapse of Oracle’s wider business; Oracle/Palantir partnership is not paid adoption. Costco fees and Dollar General supply-chain changes remain announced operating levers needing customer/execution confirmation. No regular-close return is described as the reaction to later news. YouTube is a business/valuation argument inside a larger parent, not a separate quoted security. Refined-copper imports do not become final consumption. Weight-loss discontinuation is limited to patients and period studied, not clinical uselessness.

Chinese short-selling restrictions are market-mechanics support, distinct from consumer demand and earnings. IIF emerging-market portfolio flows, Indian mutual-fund flows, Goldman hedge-fund commodity buying and technology-heavy fund composition retain separate scopes and are not summed. Polish One Box expansion, Budimex tender win, Dino format and miners’ wage demands each receive distinct execution tests; grocery searches do not establish guilt. Bullish technology/communication/staples/power calls and mixed health/energy calls remain consistent with their conditions; bearish autos includes an improvement/cover condition.

style_depth.assessment: All 36 blocks offer concrete comparisons, mechanisms and conditions for adding/reducing risk. CN separates price inflation, trading restrictions, expected loans, resale transactions, developer stress, tariff routes, innovation and final demand. PL separates network/tender/format catalysts from funding, rent yields, legal risk and labor economics, ending with substantive divergence. Themes describe research opportunities without unsupported ownership statistics. The draft contains no substantive premise requiring replacement.
style_depth.limits: Headline-level evidence and completed observations support the stated claims; the review does not validate unseen article detail, private positioning, unpublished release content or future results.
